terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions explain the rules that apply when you use the Rhino Tours & Travels website, submit an enquiry, create an account or interact with our services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By accessing or using the Rhino Tours & Travels website, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the website or submit information through our services.

sections.title: 2. About Our Website
paragraphs: Rhino Tours & Travels provides information about destinations, travel experiences and related tourism services across Northeast India.

Information displayed on the website is intended to help travellers explore available options and submit enquiries. Website content does not by itself constitute a confirmed booking or contractual reservation.

sections.title: 3. Travel Enquiries
paragraphs: When you submit an enquiry, you may provide information such as your name, email address, phone number, preferred destination, travel dates, number of travellers, trip type and additional travel requirements.

Submitting an enquiry does not guarantee availability, pricing or confirmation of any travel service. A booking becomes confirmed only after Rhino Tours & Travels communicates the applicable itinerary, price, availability and booking conditions and the traveller accepts those arrangements.

sections.title: 4. Prices and Availability
paragraphs: Travel prices, accommodation, transport, activities, permits and other services may vary depending on availability, season, travel dates, group size and third-party service providers.
Any prices discussed during an enquiry are subject to confirmation before a booking is finalized.

sections.title: 5. User Accounts
paragraphs: Certain features may allow you to create or access an account using email authentication or supported third-party sign-in services.
You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and for information submitted through it. You should notify us if you believe your account is being used without authorization.

sections.title: 6. Reviews
paragraphs: Authenticated users may be able to submit ratings, comments and optional location information about their travel experience.
Reviews should reflect genuine experiences and must not contain unlawful, abusive, misleading, defamatory, discriminatory, threatening or inappropriate content.
items: Do not impersonate another person.
Do not submit spam or promotional content as a review.
Do not publish private or confidential information about another person.
Do not intentionally submit false or misleading information.

sections.title: 7. WhatsApp Communications
paragraphs: If you voluntarily provide your phone number and choose to receive WhatsApp communications, Rhino Tours & Travels may send messages relating to your enquiry, travel request or other relevant service updates.
WhatsApp communications will only be used in connection with the services and permissions described to you. You may choose not to provide WhatsApp consent.

sections.title: 8. Website Content
paragraphs: Destination descriptions, itineraries, photographs, travel information and other website content are provided for general informational purposes.
Conditions at destinations may change due to weather, road conditions, government restrictions, seasonal closures, local regulations or other circumstances beyond our control.

sections.title: 9. Third-Party Services
paragraphs: Travel arrangements may involve third-party providers such as hotels, transport operators, guides, activity providers and other tourism services.
The availability and performance of third-party services may be subject to their own policies, terms and operational conditions.

sections.title: 10. Acceptable Use
paragraphs: You agree not to misuse the website or attempt to interfere with its normal operation.
items: Do not attempt unauthorized access to accounts, servers or systems.
Do not introduce malicious software, automated abuse or harmful code.
Do not use the website for unlawful or fraudulent purposes.
Do not attempt to collect information about other users without authorization.

sections.title: 11. Intellectual Property
paragraphs: Unless otherwise stated, website branding, original text, graphics, layout and other original materials associated with Rhino Tours & Travels may not be copied, reproduced or commercially used without appropriate permission.
Third-party trademarks, images or materials remain the property of their respective owners.

sections.title: 12. Service Changes
paragraphs: We may update, modify, suspend or discontinue parts of the website or its features when necessary for maintenance, security, operational or business reasons.

sections.title: 13. Limitation of Website Information
paragraphs: While reasonable efforts are made to keep travel information accurate, Rhino Tours & Travels cannot guarantee that all website information will always be complete, current or error-free.
Travellers should confirm important travel requirements, availability and arrangements before making travel decisions.

sections.title: 14. Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: These Terms & Conditions may be updated when our services, website features or operational practices change. The latest version will be published on this page together with the date of the most recent update.

contact.title: Questions About These Terms
contact.description: If you have questions about these Terms & Conditions, please contact Rhino Tours & Travels through the contact information provided on our website.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information Rhino Tours & Travels collects through this website, why we use it and how it may be stored or shared when you use our services.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect personal information only when it is required to provide website features, respond to travel enquiries, manage user accounts or support other services requested by you.
items: Name and email address associated with your account.
Profile photo and sign-in provider information when available through supported authentication services.
Phone number when you submit a travel enquiry.
Preferred destination, travel dates, number of travellers, trip type and other information included in your enquiry.
Ratings, review comments and optional location information submitted through the review feature.
Your choice about whether you consent to receive WhatsApp communications.

sections.title: 2. Account and Authentication Information
paragraphs: The website uses Firebase Authentication to provide account registration and sign-in features, including email authentication and supported third-party sign-in options.
Rhino Tours & Travels does not store your account password in its own database. Authentication credentials are handled by the authentication provider.

After authentication, limited account information such as your user identifier, name, email address, profile photo and sign-in provider may be stored in our application database so that website features can be associated with your account.

sections.title: 3. Travel Enquiry Information
paragraphs: When you submit a travel enquiry, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, destination preference, travel dates, number of travellers, trip type and any additional message you provide.
This information is used to understand your travel requirements, respond to your enquiry and communicate with you about relevant travel services.

sections.title: 4. WhatsApp Communications
paragraphs: If you provide your phone number and voluntarily choose to receive WhatsApp communications, we may use your number to send messages related to your travel enquiry or relevant service updates.
WhatsApp consent is optional. Submitting an enquiry does not require you to consent to WhatsApp communications.
WhatsApp messages may be delivered using services provided by Meta and may therefore be processed according to the applicable policies of that service provider.

sections.title: 5. Reviews
paragraphs: Authenticated users may submit ratings, comments and optional location information through the review feature.
A review may be associated with your account name and profile photo so that it can be displayed as part of the website's review section.
Information you intentionally include in a published review may be visible to other visitors of the website.

sections.title: 6. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: Personal information collected through the website may be used for the following purposes:
items: To create and manage user accounts.
To authenticate users and maintain signed-in sessions.
To respond to travel enquiries and understand travel requirements.
To provide enquiry-related communications and service updates.
To display and manage user-submitted reviews.
To maintain the security, reliability and operation of the website.
To investigate misuse, technical issues or unauthorized activity.

sections.title: 7. How Information Is Stored
paragraphs: Application data such as user profiles, travel enquiries and reviews may be stored in secure database infrastructure used by Rhino Tours & Travels.
Authentication information is handled through Firebase Authentication, while application records may be stored separately in our database.
Although reasonable security measures are used, no method of electronic storage or transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.title: 8. Service Providers
paragraphs: We use third-party technology providers to operate parts of the website and its services. These may include authentication providers, database and hosting services, email services and communication platforms.
These providers may process limited information when necessary to deliver the services they provide to us. Their handling of information is also subject to their own privacy and security practices.

sections.title: 9. Sharing of Personal Information
paragraphs: Rhino Tours & Travels does not sell personal information.

Personal information may be shared only when reasonably necessary to provide requested services, operate the website, work with relevant service providers, comply with legal obligations or protect the security and rights of users and the business.

sections.title: 10. Browser Storage and Session Information
paragraphs: The website and services used by it may use cookies, browser storage or similar technologies when necessary for authentication, session management, language preferences and other essential website functionality.
These technologies help the website remember certain settings and maintain features such as signed-in sessions.

sections.title: 11. Data Retention
paragraphs: Personal information is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, to provide services, maintain relevant business records, resolve disputes, prevent misuse or meet applicable legal obligations.
Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and the purpose for which it is stored.

sections.title: 12. Your Choices and Requests
paragraphs: You may contact Rhino Tours & Travels if you would like to ask about personal information associated with you or request that inaccurate information be corrected or that eligible information be deleted.
Some information may need to be retained where required for security, record-keeping, dispute resolution or applicable legal obligations.

sections.title: 13. External Services and Links
paragraphs: The website may include links to or integrations with third-party websites and services. Rhino Tours & Travels is not responsible for the privacy practices of external websites or services that we do not control.
You should review the privacy policies of those services before providing personal information to them.

sections.title: 14. Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures intended to protect personal information against unauthorized access, misuse, alteration or loss.
Users are also responsible for protecting access to their accounts and should avoid sharing account credentials with others.

sections.title: 15. Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated when website features, data practices, service providers or legal requirements change. The latest version will be published on this page with the date of the most recent update.

contact.title: Privacy Questions
contact.description: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your personal information is handled, please contact Rhino Tours & Travels using the contact information provided on our website.

about.title: Discover Northeast India With People Who Know It
about.descriptionOne: Rhino Tours & Travels is dedicated to creating meaningful journeys across Northeast India, bringing travelers closer to its landscapes, wildlife, cultures and communities.
about.descriptionTwo: From the grasslands of Assam to the mountains of Arunachal Pradesh and the waterfalls of Meghalaya, we aim to make every journey comfortable, personal and memorable.
about.quote: We believe the best journeys are not only about the places you visit, but also the people, stories and experiences you discover along the way.
